subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt and rebase the open conflicting fork PR for this Debug Snapshots repair, or close/supersede it and use a fresh current-main fix?
rationale: The bug remains valid, but a linked open fork PR already proposes the repair and is conflicting, so opening a duplicate automated fix before choosing the path would create churn.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against the current route-owned Debug page with localization, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase The Fork PR
options.body: Keep the contributor path, but require rebase, current Debug page changes, localization, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Into Broader Diagnostics
options.body: Leave this issue open without a repair path if maintainers want to fold it into the broader Control UI diagnostics work.

recommendation.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against the current route-owned Debug page with localization, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source and feature-history evidence tie steipete to both the original Debug surface and the current route-owned Debug page boundary.
